title: 卡莎·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 深紫头发与颊侧紫纹相互呼应，两枚弯曲的活体肩部囊舱清楚分立。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Kai'Sa is an adult woman with long dark violet hair, violet cheek markings, alert purple eyes, and two distinctive curved living shoulder pods. Preserve the organic purple carapace silhouette with a fully opaque high-neck long-sleeved bodysuit, covered legs, gloves, and boots, without exposed chest or midriff. The shoulder pods stay folded and inactive, and her posture is composed rather than predatory.
art_direction.scene: A closer three-quarter study with all essential anatomy and props included, expressive head and strongly varied line weight. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: violet, clear sky blue, lavender edge, pale amber; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
